a:
STYLE: 1930s rubber hose cartoon, hand-inked cel animation look, original characters.
Thick uniform outline in dark plum #3D3346 on every shape, clean confident lines, no sketchy strokes.
Flat cel colors with at most one soft shade tone per color, no gradients on characters, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic look; one small white highlight dot is allowed.
Characters: bendy rubber hose arms and legs with no elbows or knees, white four-finger cartoon gloves, big round shoes, pie-cut eyes (black ovals with a small wedge cut out), simple wide mouth, big head-to-body ratio.
Character colors are saturated: red #D2463C, blue #3E6DB5, yellow #F2C14E, cream #F4E6C8, glove white #FBF6EA.
Backgrounds and large props look like faded watercolor on paper in beige #CFAC8D, sand #D7BE97, dusty navy #4E546E, muted olive #8A9A6B, warm grey #907F77, and are LESS saturated than the characters.
Soft light from the top-left. No cast shadow on the ground. No text, letters or numbers anywhere.
Do not copy any existing cartoon or game character, logo, or scene.

Each item isolated on a flat solid #FF00FF magenta background (or transparent), full figure visible, nothing cropped, wide empty margin around every item, no ground line, no floor, no frame, no border, no shadow under the item.
Characters face the viewer at a slight high 3/4 angle unless a direction is given. "Side" always means facing RIGHT.

Strict side view for a 2D side-scrolling game, the camera is level with the ground (not from above). Characters face RIGHT.
Tiles and background layers marked "connect seamlessly" must match exactly at the LEFT and RIGHT edges so they can repeat.
Mid layers: draw only the lower part, leave the upper part empty flat #FF00FF magenta.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for Windup Town. All attached inputs are references only: anchor controls ink/color style; reference character and stage images control drawing technique only (do not copy their characters); road1 and road3 backgrounds control warm/cool region palettes; bush and key control existing prop designs. No characters or faces in this sheet. Pure uniform #FF00FF background including all holes. No labels, writing, logos, borders, cast shadows or decorative loose specks. Orthographic 2D side-scrolling props, no isometric or top-down perspective. Generous margins and separation.
Create exactly SEVEN separate sprites in TWO rows: top row FOUR items, bottom row THREE items. All item vertical centers in each row share one horizontal line. Leave large magenta gaps. Top row left-to-right: grass ground square, wooden plank platform, tall bush, thin puddle. Bottom row left-to-right: wind-up gear lift, long flat drawbridge, gramophone checkpoint post. Warm muted olive, brown wood, golden brass, curved friendly silhouettes. Ground tile is an orthographic SQUARE cross-section with perfectly flat vertical sides, no side wall ink strokes at repeat seams: left/right edge colors and grass heights identical. Platform about 4:1; puddle about 8:1; drawbridge long and flat with short attached chains, not a tall suspension bridge. Keep all pieces connected per item.

road_ground_grass: a square side-view tile of grassy dirt ground: a band of olive grass on top, brown earth with small pebbles below, LEFT and RIGHT edges connect seamlessly
road_platform_wood: a floating wooden plank platform seen from the side, three planks with rope bindings, about four times wider than tall
road_bush_tall: a tall round bush seen from the side, puffy lobes, as tall as a short wall
road_puddle: a flat shallow water puddle seen from the side, light blue with small ripple lines and a white highlight, wide and very thin
road_wind_lift: a wooden platform on top of a big brass gear column with a wind-up key socket on its front, side view
road_drawbridge: a wooden drawbridge plank with two iron chains attached at the top end, side view, long and flat
road_wind_post: a short wooden post topped with a small brass gramophone horn and a little wind-up key on its side, side view, friendly

Create exactly NINE separate sprites arranged in TWO rows: top row FIVE items, bottom row FOUR items. All item vertical centers in each row share one horizontal line. Top row left-to-right: square metal ground, shutter closed, shutter open, conveyor segment, automatic door closed. Bottom row left-to-right: automatic door open, rail elevator, charging post, sparking broken cable. Cool grey #9BA3AE and steel #6E7884; straight lines; small orange #E07A3A lights only where requested. Shutter pair must have IDENTICAL overall width/height, outer frame, scale, placement; open state has magenta empty opening and rolled slats at top inside the same frame. Cable sparks are grey/white electrical zigzags connected at tip.

road_ground_metal: a square side-view tile of grey riveted metal floor with a darker under-layer, straight lines, LEFT and RIGHT edges connect seamlessly
road_shutter_closed: a grey corrugated metal shutter fully closed, side-scroller front view, tall rectangle
road_shutter_open: the same grey metal shutter rolled up at the top, open doorway below
road_conveyor: one segment of a grey conveyor belt with rollers seen from the side, LEFT and RIGHT edges connect seamlessly
road_door_closed: a grey sliding automatic door with a small orange sensor light on top, closed, tall rectangle
road_door_open: the same grey automatic door slid open to both sides, orange sensor light on
road_elevator: a flat metal elevator platform between two vertical grey rails, a small orange light on the side
road_charger: a grey charging station post with a coiled cable and a plug hanging on a hook, a round orange light on top, plain with NO text or symbols
road_spark_wire: a broken grey electric cable lying across the ground with grey and white zigzag sparks at its tip

Use case: stylized-concept. Create TWO production tile sprites only, on flat solid magenta #FF00FF with wide margins, side by side, same size. Supporting references: anchor ink style, character/stage drawing technique only, warm field and cool city palette, bush/key props. No characters. LEFT: grassy earth SQUARE tile. RIGHT: grey riveted metal SQUARE tile. Both precisely square flat front cross sections, straight horizontal tops and bottoms, perfectly straight vertical sides. No perspective, no visible top surface. Grass tile has a straight olive grass band across top 15% with modest scallops along its bottom; brown dirt and few small pebbles below. NO protruding grass tufts above top. Grey tile has flat steel plate band across top 20%, darker grey support layer below, sparse rivets set away from edges. LEFT/RIGHT seam columns must be identical colors at every height; flat undecorated vertical 10% margins on each tile; NO ink outline on vertical edges, only top/bottom ink. NO gradients or paper grain. Square objects surrounded by magenta, NOT full-canvas textures.
road_ground_grass: a square side-view tile of grassy dirt ground: a band of olive grass on top, brown earth with small pebbles below, LEFT and RIGHT edges connect seamlessly
road_ground_metal: a square side-view tile of grey riveted metal floor with a darker under-layer, straight lines, LEFT and RIGHT edges connect seamlessly
